stories.label: Moody's recession probability crosses 50% on oil spike
stories.summary: Moody's recession indicator crosses 50%, correctly predicted 2020/2007/2001 recessions. US lost 92K jobs Feb, unemployment 4.4%, GDP revised to 0.7%.

stories.label: Taiwan $14B arms deal on track despite Trump-Xi May summit
stories.summary: Taiwan confirms $14B US arms package on track after receiving letter of guarantee. Deal includes advanced interceptor missiles. Xi warned Trump to handle carefully. Iran war delayed Trump-Xi summit to May 14-15.

stories.label: Philippines declares first national energy emergency from Iran war
stories.summary: Philippines first country to declare national energy emergency. Fuel prices doubled. Transport workers strike in Manila. Government imposed 4-day work week for civil servants.

stories.label: UN votes 123-3 to declare slave trade gravest crime against humanity
stories.summary: UNGA voted 123-3 (US, Israel, Argentina against; UK/Portugal/Spain abstained) to declare transatlantic slave trade gravest crime against humanity. Ghana-led resolution demands reparations fund.

stories.label: Israeli settlers expanding into Areas B and A of West Bank
stories.summary: +972 joint investigation: settlers expanding beyond Area C into Areas B and A (PA jurisdiction). Displacing Palestinian communities under cover of Iran war.

stories.label: EU-Mercosur trade deal goes live May 1, bypassing European Parliament
stories.summary: EU activates Mercosur deal May 1, world's largest free trade zone (700M+ people, 30% GDP). France lost blocking effort.

stories.label: Google estimates quantum computers break encryption by 2029
stories.summary: Google revised Q Day estimate to 2029. Most banks, crypto, messaging haven't migrated to post-quantum cryptography.

stories.label: Zelenskyy: US conditioning security guarantees on ceding Donbas
stories.summary: Zelenskyy tells Reuters US pressuring Ukraine to surrender Donbas for security guarantees. Iran war giving Trump leverage.

stories.label: Western economies weighing bans on religious slaughter
stories.summary: European religious slaughter bans expanding. Question whether other Western economies will follow. Impacts halal supply chains globally.

stories.label: Small-molecule degrader targets undruggable KRAS cancer mutations
stories.summary: Nature Comms: Small-molecule degrader DJX-A-KM destroys KRAS protein via ubiquitin-proteasome, works across multiple mutations.

stories.label: NASA Artemis II targets April 1 for first crewed Moon mission in 53 years
stories.summary: First crewed lunar mission since Apollo 17. First woman, first person of color on Moon mission. $44B spent.

stories.label: Cuba nationwide blackout visible from satellite, oil crisis deepens
stories.summary: NASA satellite shows Cuba going dark. Oil = 83% of electricity. Venezuelan shipments collapsed, US sanctions + Iran war compounding.

stories.label: Hungary cuts gas to Ukraine over Druzhba oil pipeline dispute
stories.summary: Orban announces Hungary will phase out gas deliveries to Ukraine until Russian oil flows resume through Druzhba pipeline. Third retaliatory measure after diesel cutoff and EU loan veto.

stories.label: Toxic environmental fallout from Iran strikes could last decades
stories.summary: Destroyed refineries and chemical plants releasing heavy metals and carcinogens. Environmental contamination may persist decades.

stories.label: No Kings protest March 28: potentially largest US demonstration in history
stories.summary: 3,000+ events planned across all 50 states for March 28. Organizers expect to surpass 7M participants from October.

stories.label: Rothschild Paris offices raided over Epstein-linked diplomat
stories.summary: French investigators raided Edmond de Rothschild offices. Diplomat sent 200+ emails including UN Security Council briefings to Epstein.

stories.label: Raskin reveals new details on Trump classified documents — 6-person access level
stories.summary: Raskin letter: Trump stole documents accessible to only 6 people in government, showed classified map on private plane. Aide uploaded scans to cloud. Demands DOJ answers by March 31.

stories.label: Bellingcat: RSF munitions match deadly Chad strike, Sudan war crosses borders
stories.summary: Bellingcat OSINT: munition fragments at Tine, Chad strike (17 killed) match weapons previously used by Sudan's RSF. First forensic proof of cross-border RSF strikes.

stories.label: Trump-Xi Beijing summit rescheduled for May after Iran war delay
stories.summary: Trump to visit Beijing in May for first China trip in 8 years. Trip delayed by Iran war. Signals possible Chinese mediation role.

stories.label: Hezbollah guerrilla defense stalls Israeli advance at Khiam and Taybeh
stories.summary: Israel surrounded Khiam on 3 sides but cannot take the hilltop center. Hezbollah 'kill pockets' stall armored advance. Khiam controls routes to Beqaa Valley — capture would isolate all of southern Lebanon. Retired Lebanese general describes tactical stalemate.

stories.label: Palestinian prisoners cut off from lawyers under Iran war lockdown
stories.summary: Israel locked down prisons at start of Iran war, barring almost all lawyer visits. Thousands of Palestinian prisoners in administrative detention now have zero outside contact.

stories.label: Islamic finance expands into Caucasus — ICD funds Azerbaijan SME lending
stories.summary: ICD extends $15M to Azerbaijan's Turan Bank for SME lending. Part of broader Islamic finance geographic expansion: Turkcell $1B murabaha (Turkey), now Caucasus.

stories.label: World's largest pirated sports streaming network taken down in Egypt
stories.summary: Two men in Sheikh Zayed, Egypt ran StreamEast — 1.6B visits/year, 136M/month. 22-officer raid. Mada Masr obtained case files. LeBron James caught watching it courtside.

stories.label: False claims in widely-cited business paper — no corrections, no consequences
stories.summary: Columbia statistician documents provably false claims in heavily-cited business school paper. Peer review failed, journal didn't act, institution didn't investigate. 252 HN points.

stories.label: Global dengue observatory launches with 88-country surveillance
stories.summary: New global dengue observatory collects real-time data from 88 countries. First coordinated planetary-scale vector disease surveillance as dengue expands into temperate zones.

stories.label: Oxford meta-analysis: stored sperm deteriorates with intergenerational effects
stories.summary: Oxford meta-analysis of 55,000 men and 30 species: stored sperm shows DNA damage, reduced motility, and reduced embryo viability. Published in Proceedings of the Royal Society B.

stories.label: Security researcher boots Tesla compute unit from crashed car parts
stories.summary: Security researcher reconstructed Tesla Model 3 compute unit from salvage parts, booted full system on desk. 568 HN points. Reveals vehicle data persistence after crash.

stories.label: Lebanon's telecom has no emergency plan 15 months after 2024 war
stories.summary: Southern Lebanon network still unrepaired 15 months after 2024 war. No emergency connectivity plan. Government fast-tracked Starlink for select entities only, not civilians.

stories.label: Israeli QR code leaflets in Lebanon double as surveillance tools
stories.summary: Israeli aircraft dropped leaflets with QR codes linking to WhatsApp/Facebook. SMEX analysis: scanning exposes phone number, device fingerprint, network info to Israeli intelligence. Dual-purpose: psyops + surveillance.
